services.title: Title Insurance
services.summary: Evidence of title and insured ownership.
services.text: Our title solutions provide evidence of title and insure real property ownership, the cornerstone to a safe and successful home purchase.
services.lead: Americans buy homeowner's insurance to protect the future of a house. Title insurance protects it against the past, by covering challenges to rightful ownership that arise from the circumstances of past ownerships.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of downtown Houston in late afternoon light

covers.title: The title search
covers.text: We conduct a diligent search of the public records for the documents associated with the property.

covers.title: Examination
covers.text: Those recorded documents are examined to determine whether any rights or claims may have an impact upon the title.

covers.title: What a search can turn up
covers.text: Unpaid taxes, unsatisfied mortgages, judgments and tax liens against current or past owners, easements, restrictions and court actions.

covers.title: Clearing before closing
covers.text: Recorded defects, liens and encumbrances are reported to you before the purchase, so they can be accepted, resolved or extinguished before the transaction closes.

covers.title: Policy issuance
covers.text: Policies are underwritten by Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company, with title clearance and policy issuance across the U.S.

questions.q: Why is title insurance different from other insurance?
questions.a: Most insurance pays for a future loss caused by a future event. Title insurance covers future claims and losses that come from a defect created by a past event, before you acquired the property.

questions.q: How do you find out what claims exist?
questions.a: We search the public records for the documents associated with the property, then examine them for rights or claims that could affect the title, and report what we find to you before you buy.

questions.q: What about claims a search cannot find?
questions.a: Hidden risks are matters not shown by the public records and so not discoverable by a search of them - forgery, incompetency or incapacity of the parties, fraudulent impersonation and unknown errors in the records. The policy covers those claims too, which is the second benefit you receive from title insurance.

questions.q: What does the policy actually do if a claim is made?
questions.a: Commonwealth Title defends your title, in court if necessary, at no cost to you, and bears the cost of settling the case if the claim proves valid, so your title and your possession of the property are maintained.

questions.q: How often do I pay the premium?
questions.a: Once. Unlike other forms of insurance, the original premium is your only cost for as long as you own the property. There are no annual payments to keep an Owner's Title Insurance Policy in force.

services.title: Closing & Escrow
services.text: Competent funds disbursements, purchase contract execution and seamless property ownership transfer are the keys to our successful closings.
services.lead: An escrow is an arrangement in which a disinterested third party, called an escrow holder or settlement agent, holds legal documents and funds on behalf of a buyer and seller, and distributes them according to the buyer's and seller's instructions.

covers.title: The impartial stake-holder
covers.text: Acting as the depository of documents and funds, and keeping all parties informed of progress on the escrow.

covers.title: Documents and funds
covers.text: Processing and coordinating the flow of documents and funds, and responding to the lender's requirements.

covers.title: Prorations and adjustments
covers.text: Prorating and adjusting insurance, taxes and rents between the parties.

covers.title: Recording
covers.text: Recording the deed and loan documents, and maintaining security and accountability of monies owed and owing.

covers.title: The policy
covers.text: Securing a title insurance policy and obtaining approvals of reports and documents from the parties as required.

covers.title: The residential closing, start to finish
covers.text: Preparing the Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure, distributing funds, recording documents and arranging home warranty.

questions.a: The settlement agent allocates each party's proportionate share of an obligation paid or due, such as property taxes or homeowners association dues, calculated per day from the date of closing. On semi-annual property taxes of $665.05 prepaid by the seller to July 1st and a closing on June 15, 15 days are due back to the seller at $3.69 a day, a credit of $55.35 to the seller and a charge of $55.35 to the buyer.
Once all the terms and conditions of both parties' instructions have been fulfilled and the closing conditions satisfied, the escrow is closed and the transfer of property and money is accomplished.

The method of dividing the charges varies from place to place. Unless the buyer and seller agree otherwise, local custom generally decides how the title premium, escrow settlement fee, transfer taxes, recording fees and loan costs are split.

services.title: 1031 Exchange
services.summary: Tax deferred exchanges of investment property.
services.text: We facilitate tax deferred exchanges, the strategy that involves exchanging one like-kind property for another for deferred tax gain treatment.
services.lead: In addition to traditional buy and sell transactions, we facilitate and support 1031 Exchanges of investment properties for tax deferral and to maximize investment dollars.

covers.title: What a 1031 Exchange does
covers.text: A properly structured tax deferred exchange under Internal Revenue Code section 1031 allows businesses and individuals to defer the recognition of capital gains and other taxes associated with a sale.

covers.title: Like-kind property
covers.text: In general, any type of US real property held for productive use in a trade or business, or for investment purposes, can be exchanged for more real property as long as the properties are of like kind.

covers.title: The Qualified Intermediary
covers.text: To complete an exchange, clients must engage a professional Qualified Intermediary. Exchange solutions are provided through Investment Property Exchange Services, Inc. (IPX1031).

covers.title: Services offered
covers.text: IPX1031 covers Real Estate, Personal Property, Multiple Asset and Aircraft exchanges, through to the more complicated Reverse and Improvement and Master Like-Kind Exchange Programs.

covers.title: How exchange funds are secured
covers.text: To secure a client's exchange funds, IPX1031 carries a $100 million fidelity bond, a $50 million written performance guarantee and $30 million in errors and omissions professional liability insurance.

questions.q: How do I start an exchange?
questions.a: Call us, or go to ipx1031.com or call 888-771-1031 for more information or to initiate a 1031 Exchange.
Yes. IPX1031 runs complimentary online 1031 Introduction and Advanced webinars you can register for at ipx1031.com.

covers.title: Accommodation recording
covers.text: One document or one thousand, recorded through our network of local offices and web-based electronic recording, with document tracking, retrieval and feedback on rejected documents.

covers.title: Proceedings and necessary party exams

covers.title: Non-record claimants
covers.text: Affidavit and publication notice work to identify unknown parties - the affidavit filed with the court clerk after the notice of foreclosure is recorded, and the publication notice at least 30 days before a judgment of foreclosure is entered - so a property forecloses on schedule without later claims, followed by a title commitment once judgment is issued.

facts.heading: Wire fraud alert
facts.text: Realtors, real estate brokers, buyers and sellers are targets for wire fraud, and many have lost hundreds of thousands of dollars because they simply relied on wiring instructions received by email. A hacker breaks into a licensee's email account to learn about upcoming transactions, then, posing as the escrow agent or the licensee, emails the buyer new wiring instructions or routing information, and requests that the funds be sent accordingly. Inquire before you wire: ask us for the wiring instructions and learn how to protect your purchase before you send funds.
